exec: pm.test('Root responds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.equal('Hello World!'); });

const body=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Entitled fixture login',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid'));pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;pm.collectionVariables.set('entitledAccessToken',body.accessToken);});

const body=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Unentitled fixture login',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.variables.get('unentitledUserUuid'));pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;pm.collectionVariables.set('unentitledAccessToken',body.accessToken);});

const genres=pm.response.json();pm.test('Existing genre response remains an array',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(genres).to.be.an('array');genres.forEach(genre=>pm.expect(Object.keys(genre).sort()).to.eql(['code','id','name','tileImage']));});

item.name: All catalog pages and stable ordering

exec: const body=pm.response.json();const exact=(value,keys)=>pm.expect(Object.keys(value).sort()).to.eql(keys.slice().sort());pm.test('Page one uses the common response',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);exact(body,['items','page','hasNext']);pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(1);pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array').and.have.lengthOf.at.most(30);pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.be.a('boolean');body.items.forEach(item=>{pm.expect(item.uuid).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);pm.expect(item.previewVideos).to.be.an('array');});});pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogPageOne',JSON.stringify(body.items));

const body=pm.response.json();const first=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('catalogPageOne'));pm.test('Page two follows the common response without repeating page one items',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['hasNext','items','page']);pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(2);pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array').and.have.lengthOf.at.most(30);pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.be.a('boolean');pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).not.to.include.members(first.map(item=>item.uuid));});

const body=pm.response.json();const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExpectedUuids'));pm.test('31 matches split into stable 30 and 1 pages',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(1);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(expected.slice(0,30));pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(true);});pm.collectionVariables.set('catalogFixturePageOne',JSON.stringify(body.items));

const body=pm.response.json();const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExpectedUuids'));pm.test('Second page matches the remaining fixture',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(2);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(expected.slice(30));pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(false);});

const body=pm.response.json();pm.test('Exactly 30 matches have no next page',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogThirtyExpectedUuids')));pm.expect(body.items).to.have.lengthOf(30);pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(false);});
const body=pm.response.json();pm.test('No matches return an empty common page',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body).to.deep.equal({items:[],page:1,hasNext:false});});

item.name: Search finds a title on page two

exec: const body=pm.response.json();pm.test('Search starts at page one after filtering',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(1);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql([JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExpectedUuids'))[30]]);pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(false);});

const body=pm.response.json();pm.test('Percent underscore and escape are literal',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogLiteralExpectedUuids')));});

item.name: Genre code and title search combine

exec: const body=pm.response.json();pm.test('Genre filter applies before pagination without duplicates',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogGenreExpectedUuids')));pm.expect(new Set(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).size).to.equal(body.items.length);pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(false);});

const body=pm.response.json();const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExpectedUuids'));pm.test('Genre name participates in search before pagination',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(expected.slice(0,30));pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(true);});

exec: const body=pm.response.json();const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExpectedUuids'));pm.test('Genre name search returns the final result on page two',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(expected.slice(30));pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(2);pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(false);});
pm.test('Unknown genre is an empty result',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal({items:[],page:1,hasNext:false});});
pm.test('Out of range page is empty and retains requested page',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal({items:[],page:3,hasNext:false});});

item.name: Preview save is scoped to the JWT user

exec: const base=pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}').replace(/\/+$/,'');const preview=pm.variables.get('catalogPreviewVideoUuid');const tokenA=pm.collectionVariables.get('entitledAccessToken');const tokenB=pm.collectionVariables.get('unentitledAccessToken');const send=(method,path,token)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>pm.sendRequest({url:base+path,method,header:Object.assign({'Content-Type':'application/json'},token?{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}:{}),...(method==='PUT'?{body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({contentType:'PREVIEW'})}}:{})},(error,response)=>error?reject(error):resolve(response)));const findIn=(items,uuid)=>items.flatMap(drama=>drama.previewVideos.map(video=>({drama,video}))).find(item=>item.video.uuid===uuid);const first=pm.response.json().items;(async()=>{let saved=false;try{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(findIn(first,preview).video.isSaved).to.equal(false);const write=await send('PUT','/me/saved-videos/'+preview,tokenA);pm.expect(write.code).to.equal(204);saved=true;const read=async(token,spoof)=>{const path='/dramas?genre='+encodeURIComponent(pm.variables.get('catalogGenreCodeA'))+(spoof?'&userUuid='+encodeURIComponent(pm.variables.get('unentitledUserUuid')):'');const response=await send('GET',path,token);pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200);return response.json().items;};pm.expect(findIn(await read(tokenA,false),preview).video.isSaved).to.equal(true);pm.expect(findIn(await read(tokenA,true),preview).video.isSaved).to.equal(true);pm.expect(findIn(await read(tokenB,false),preview).video.isSaved).to.equal(false);pm.expect(findIn(await read(null,false),preview).video.isSaved).to.equal(false);}finally{if(saved){const deleted=await send('DELETE','/me/saved-videos/'+preview,tokenA);pm.expect(deleted.code).to.equal(204);const restored=await send('GET','/dramas?genre='+encodeURIComponent(pm.variables.get('catalogGenreCodeA')),tokenA);pm.expect(restored.code).to.equal(200);pm.expect(findIn(restored.json().items,preview).video.isSaved).to.equal(false);}}})().catch(error=>pm.test('Preview save identity and cleanup checks complete',()=>{throw error;}));

item.name: Hidden future and undated catalog fixtures are excluded

exec: const body=pm.response.json();const excluded=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExcludedUuids'));pm.test('Only published catalog fixtures appear',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).not.to.include.members(excluded);});
pm.test('Invalid page uses common bad request',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(400);pm.expect(pm.response.json().errorCode).to.equal('HTTP_BAD_REQUEST');});

const base=pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}').replace(/\/+$/,'');const query=pm.variables.get('catalogAllQuery');const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('catalogExpectedUuids'));const request=new URLSearchParams({sort:'latest',q:'  '+query.toLowerCase()+'  ',page:'1'});(async()=>{const response=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>pm.sendRequest({url:base+'/dramas?'+request.toString(),method:'GET'},(error,value)=>error?reject(error):resolve(value)));const body=response.json();pm.test('Trim and case-insensitive q search matches the same first page',()=>{pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200);pm.expect(body.items.map(item=>item.uuid)).to.eql(expected.slice(0,30));pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(true);});})().catch(error=>pm.test('Trim and case-insensitive search completes',()=>{throw error;}));

const base=pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}').replace(/\/+$/,'');const send=(path,token)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>pm.sendRequest({url:base+path,method:'GET',header:token?{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}:{}},(error,response)=>error?reject(error):resolve(response)));const cases=['/dramas?page=1&page=2','/dramas?q=a&q=b','/dramas?q%5Bname%5D=a','/dramas?genre=ROMANCE&genre=DRAMA','/dramas?genre%5Bname%5D=a','/dramas?sort=invalid'];(async()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(400);const token=pm.collectionVariables.get('entitledAccessToken');for(const path of cases){const response=await send(path,token);pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(400);const body=response.json();pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['errorCode','errorName','path','statusCode','timestamp']);pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.equal('HTTP_BAD_REQUEST');pm.expect(body.path).to.equal(new URL(base+path).pathname+new URL(base+path).search);}const denied=await send('/dramas', 'invalid.access.token');pm.expect(denied.code).to.equal(401);pm.expect(denied.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN');})().catch(error=>pm.test('Filter and identity input checks complete',()=>{throw error;}));
